job.title: Systems Engineer- Healthcare MSP
job.description:
• Norwest Location
  • $110-$120k + super
  • Healthcare experience is a must!

Are you a Systems Engineer with a strong healthcare MSP background and the technical skills to tackle complex infrastructure challenges?

We're partnering with a specialist IT services business to find an experienced Systems Engineer to join their team in Norwest.

This is an opportunity for a technically strong MSP professional who enjoys solving complex technical issues, supporting healthcare clients and delivering infrastructure solutions across diverse client environments.

You'll take ownership of escalated technical issues, contribute to infrastructure projects and provide technical guidance to junior team members.

Important: You must have at least five years' experience working within a healthcare Managed Service Provider (MSP), with hands-on experience supporting healthcare practice management systems.

The opportunity
Reporting to the Service Delivery Manager, you'll provide advanced Level 2 and Level 3 technical support across the helpdesk and projects teams.

You'll work across servers, networking, cloud platforms, virtualisation and security, helping healthcare clients maintain reliable, secure and effective IT environments.

What you'll be doing

  • Provide advanced Level 2 and Level 3 technical support across multiple client environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex server, network, cloud, hardware and software issues.
  • Support healthcare practice management systems, including Medical Director, Best Practice and Genie.
  • Manage escalated tickets and ensure timely resolution within agreed service levels.
  • Deploy, configure and maintain servers, workstations, firewalls, applications and network infrastructure.
  • Administer and support Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory and Group Policy.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, VPNs, wireless networks and firewall technologies.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, deployments and project implementations.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation and client environment records.
  • Provide onsite technical support and professional services to clients.
  • Mentor junior technicians and provide technical guidance on complex issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure, processes and service delivery.

What you'll bringEssential experience

  • Minimum five years' experience working within a healthcare Managed Service Provider (MSP).
  • Experience in a Level 2 or Level 3 technical support or Systems Engineer role within an MSP.
  • Hands-on experience supporting healthcare practice management systems, particularly Medical Director, Best Practice and/or Genie.
  • Strong Microsoft infrastructure knowledge, including Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
  • Solid networking and troubleshooting skills across routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs and wireless environments.
  • Experience managing technical escalations and supporting multiple client environments.
  • Strong client communication skills and a customer-focused approach.
  • Current Australian driver's licence and the ability to provide onsite client support.

Technical skills

Ideally, you'll also bring experience across several of the following technologies:

  • Servers: Windows Server 2022/2025, server builds, deployments and troubleshooting.
  • Microsoft: Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
  • Networking and security: Cisco, Fortinet and/or Check Point firewalls, routers, switches and VPNs.
  • Virtualisation: Hyper-V, VMware and/or Citrix environments.
  • Cloud: AWS, including EC2, security solutions and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Business continuity: Backup, disaster recovery and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Projects: Infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments and implementation work.

Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, Azure or VMware certifications will be highly regarded.
The person we're looking for

You're a hands-on Systems Engineer who enjoys getting to the root of complex technical problems. You can work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership of incidents through to resolution.
You communicate technical issues clearly to clients, understand the importance of reliable IT systems in healthcare environments and take pride in delivering quality service.
You'll also enjoy sharing your knowledge, supporting junior technicians and contributing to a collaborative technical team.

What's on offer?

  • Work across complex technical environments and challenging infrastructure projects.
  • Apply your healthcare MSP expertise across a diverse client base.
  • Take ownership of escalated issues and contribute to infrastructure improvements.
  • Share your knowledge and help develop the capability of the wider technical team.
  • Join a business that values technical expertise, collaboration and quality client service.


If you're an experienced Systems Engineer with a strong healthcare MSP background and the technical capability to operate at Level 3, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more about this opportunity.

job.title: Account Manager - FMCG | Growing Business
job.description:
• $110-$120k + Super + Car Allowance
  • Career Progression to Business Manager
  • Sponsorship a possibilty for the right candidate

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has become available for an ambitious and commercially driven Account Manager to join a growing FMCG business.
This is an ideal opportunity for someone who understands FMCG and retail, enjoys working with independent customers and is motivated by growing sales and building strong commercial relationships.

You won't just be managing an existing portfolio. You'll have the opportunity to identify new opportunities, grow existing accounts and play an important role in the continued growth of the business.

For the right person, this role offers a genuine pathway into a Business Manager position as the business continues to expand.

About the Role

Working closely with independent retailers and key clients, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing and developing a portfolio of independent customers and key accounts
  • Building strong, long-term relationships with customers
  • Identifying opportunities to increase sales and grow existing accounts
  • Developing new business opportunities
  • Working closely with customers to understand their needs and identify commercial opportunities
  • Monitoring sales performance and achieving agreed targets
  • Providing market and customer insights to the broader business
  • Representing the brand professionally in the market
  • Taking ownership of your territory and driving results

About You

We're looking for someone who is commercially hungry, proactive and ambitious.
You will ideally have:

  • Experience in FMCG, retail, wholesale, field sales or a related environment
  • A strong understanding of retail and independent customers
  • Proven experience in account management, sales or business development
  • A strong commercial mindset with a focus on sales growth
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills
  • The confidence to identify opportunities and turn them into results
  • A proactive and hands-on approach
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • The ambition to take the next step in your career

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to build something and grow with the business.

What's On Offer?

  • $110-$120k+ super
  • Car allowance
  • Genuine career progression into a Business Manager role
  • Opportunity to join a growing FMCG business
  • A commercially focused role with real ownership and autonomy
  • The opportunity to make a tangible impact on business growth
  • Sponsorship may be available for the right candidate

Interested?

If you're an ambitious Account Manager who understands FMCG/retail, enjoys working with independent customers and is ready to take your career to the next level, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential conversation.

job.title: EA to CEO & Partner
job.description:
• $55-$60 + super p/hr
  • ASAP Start until January - WHV candidates welcome to apply
  • CBD Location

Work with an impressive, entrepreneurial business at the heart of Australia's technology ecosystem. We’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support a CEO & Partner in a highly respected, fast-paced and entrepreneurial business based in Sydney CBD.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an EA who enjoys working with senior leaders, thrives in a dynamic environment and wants to be part of a business that works with some of Australia's most exciting and innovative companies.
About the role You'll work closely with the CEO & Partner, providing high-level executive support and helping keep a busy schedule and priorities running smoothly.

You'll be trusted to take ownership of:

  • Complex diary and calendar management
  • Coordinating meetings with senior stakeholders, founders and business leaders
  • Travel arrangements and logistics
  • Preparing meeting materials, presentations and documents
  • Managing emails and correspondence
  • Coordinating internal and external stakeholders
  • Assisting with events, meetings and special projects
  • Following up actions and ensuring priorities stay on track
  • Ad hoc support across a genuinely varied and interesting role

This isn't a traditional, routine EA role. You'll be working in a smart, entrepreneurial environment where things move quickly and you'll have exposure to interesting people, businesses and ideas.

About you You'll ideally be an experienced EA, Executive Assistant or Senior PA who is:

  • Experienced supporting a CEO, Partner, Founder or senior executive
  • Highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented
  • Proactive and able to anticipate what needs to happen next
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
  • A confident and polished communicator
  • Discreet and trusted with confidential information
  • Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do
  • Available to start ASAP

Why this role?

  • Work closely with an influential senior leader
  • Join a genuinely interesting and entrepreneurial business
  • Be surrounded by smart, ambitious people and innovative companies
  • Sydney CBD location
  • Varied role with plenty of exposure and responsibility
  • $55–$60 per hour + super
  • ASAP start

Working Holiday Visa candidates are very welcome to apply, provided you have the appropriate working rights.

If you're an experienced EA who loves being close to the action and wants to work somewhere a little different from the traditional corporate environment, we'd love to hear from you.
